title: The Real Life
description: Creating the most realistic minecraft experience without being overwhelming.
body:
This modpack's goal is to create the most immersive experience while keeping it optional and fun.

The modpack features Create automation, weapons, and vehicles. 
Metal working and tool crafting is also more detailed with various methods to try.
Temperature is also included for a slightly more detailed survival experience.
Realistic biomes and animals have been added to make exploring more immersive.
